outline:
本課程主要在介紹經營管理的理論與實務。課程目的有3個：(1)了解經營管理相關理論的內涵；(2)對實務界人士提供具體建議；(3)將經營管理的技巧應用到生活面。
This course focuses on the theories and practices of management in business. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of the relevant theories of business management; (2) to discuss practical implications for business management and (3) to learn how to apply the basic ideas of business management in daily life.
schedule:
W1-W6：管理與決策議題
W7-W12：產業研發與創業個案
W13-W18：HBR經營管理個案討論
scorePolicy:
